name: 01-login
notes: In-app browser, fresh default RC installation. Chatwoot wordmark conflicts with product heading.

name: 02-conversation-tablet
notes: Default in-app viewport 772×695: mobile shell; message area compressed between navigation and composer.

name: 03-conversation-desktop
notes: Desktop breakpoint test at 1440×1000, synthetic booked lead selected.

name: 04-review-conversation
notes: Review queue selects correct lead, but answer-review card shows Proposed time filled with refund question and Confirm call time CTA. Verify source versus fixture.

name: 05-leads
notes: Lead list, populated synthetic account. Inspect hierarchy, search and filter discoverability.

name: 06-leads-empty
notes: Search correctly returns No leads match these filters. Visible focus ring and clear icon; no prominent reset-all action; empty detail pane remains.

name: 07-bookings
notes: Synthetic booking list and detail. Any date difference against conversation prose is fixture inconsistency, excluded from app findings.

name: 08-availability
notes: Disconnected-provider state: Failed provider load and No available slots displayed together, with no visible connect/retry guidance. Failure expected under isolated environment; recovery UX assessed only.

name: 09-knowledge
notes: Document editor with distinct Documents, Approved Answers and Needs Review tabs. Helpful sensitive-topic explanation. Save/publish/status/access toggles compete; default test prompt mentions Online Profits in standalone workspace.

name: 10-approved-answers
notes: Draft item appears under Approved Answers; detail labels draft text Approved answer. Approve/Reject/Archive available.

name: 11-answer-form
notes: New answer empty submission focuses required title via native validation; placeholder-only visible fields, aria labels present. Right detail remains for old item.

name: 12-knowledge-review
notes: Resolve defaults to sending answer to lead AND proposing reusable approved answer. Button does not disclose these effects; draft note placeholder also allows internal resolution. No message sent.

name: 13-test-center
notes: Fresh default Test Center, no test runs or live providers connected.

name: 14-release-check
notes: Launch is clearly locked, but machine identifiers in blocking checks and 0% safety failures with no runs can mislead.

name: 15-settings-qualification
notes: Budget range visibly shows 20000000 under TZS 200,000–500,000. Source directly binds min_cents; raw money units leak into form. No controls to add/edit offers on this page.

name: 16-settings-booking
notes: Readable short form, but timezone is free text; no calendar connection, weekday selector, exceptions or preview on this page.

name: 17-settings-team
notes: Intermediate page points to Open teams and exposes existing Chatwoot account configuration wording. Target team editor not inspected.

name: 18-settings-followups
notes: Delay displayed as 1440 minutes, with no natural-language schedule or message preview. Enabled is configuration only; live dispatch not exercised.

name: 19-settings-alerts
notes: Alerts leads to generic Open inboxes without alert recipients, triggers or delivery-status guidance on this page.

name: 20-settings-whatsapp
notes: WhatsApp entry is a generic Open inboxes handoff with Chatwoot wording, no connection status summary.

name: 21-inbox-settings
notes: Settings subnavigation disappears; generic multichannel explanation and unlabeled edit/delete icon controls.

name: 22-add-inbox
notes: WhatsApp V1 setup exposes Website, SMS, Email, API, Telegram and Line alongside WhatsApp; no setup submitted.

name: 23-ai-provider
notes: AI provider configuration in disconnected local test environment.

name: 24-phone-inbox
notes: Phone 390×844, Inbox opens selected conversation. Lead name readable but repeated phone; AI/Human owner status hidden until expanding details; next action truncates. Composer occupies ~230px.

name: 25-phone-brief
notes: Expanded phone brief: still no explicit Human Active or assignee; disabled Resume AI has no visible explanation.

name: 26-phone-queue
notes: Confirmed visible dead end after Back to list: Select a conversation but no list or selection control at 390px. This is loaded application state, not a blank capture.

name: 27-phone-leads
notes: At 390×844, expanded filters and stacked headers leave only part of first lead visible before fixed pagination. Import/export lose accessible names in DOM.

name: 28-phone-bookings
notes: Phone booking cards reflow and keep names readable, but tall toolbar/filters reduce available space; virtual keyboard and actual touch not tested.

name: 29-phone-settings
notes: Phone Settings loses all section navigation; Save changes wraps and clips in fixed height. Viewport and document width both390, so this is not page-wide overflow.
